card.name: Scattered words in general web prose
card.fires_on: No shared word or setting; it fires on assorted words such as 'and', 'of', 'by', a digit or a space in news and event-style web text.
card.plain: It does not respond to any one thing; it shows up on unrelated words in ordinary web articles.
